channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-121423 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | SurrealDB before 3.3.0 contains an unbounded recursion vulnerability that allows authenticated users to abort the surreald process by triggering stack overflow on deeply nested values. Attackers can repeatedly run UPDATE statements wrapping a stored array in itself, then SELECT or EXPORT it, causing persistent denial of service for all tenants.

item.title: CVE-2026-121424 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Nodemailer from 3.0.0 before 10.1.4 contains an address parsing vulnerability in addressparser that allows remote attackers to redirect recipients by ending nested RFC 5322 comments at the first closing parenthesis. Attackers can submit addresses whose nested comment hides an attacker address, bypassing conformant validators and recipient allow lists to receive mail or spoof senders in mailparser.

item.title: CVE-2026-121425 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Nodemailer from 3.0.0 before 10.1.4 contains a parsing flaw in addressparser that ends an RFC 5322 group at a semicolon inside quoted display names or comments. Attackers can submit crafted group addresses that conformant validators approve, redirecting mail to attacker-chosen recipients and bypassing recipient allow lists.

item.title: CVE-2026-121426 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Nodemailer from 3.0.0 before 10.1.4 contains an address parsing vulnerability in addressparser that ends an angle-addr at a '>' inside a quoted local part, comment or domain literal. Attackers can submit addresses that validate as an allowed domain but are delivered to an attacker-controlled domain, bypassing recipient allow lists and disclosing message content.

item.title: CVE-2026-121427 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | AzuraCast through 0.23.8 fails to remove frontend_config.custom_config in PUT /station/{id}/profile/edit for users lacking the Manage station broadcasting permission, and the stored JSON is written verbatim as key=value lines into the Shoutcast sc_serv.conf file. An authenticated user with only the Manage station profile permission can override adminpassword, password, and portbase, or inject arbitrary directives via newlines in keys, hijacking the station's Shoutcast frontend.

item.title: CVE-2026-121428 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | AzuraCast through 0.23.8 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated station managers to inject Supervisor configuration through the station timezone field. Attackers can submit a timezone containing newlines to the profile edit API, defining a new Supervisor program that executes OS commands as root when configuration regenerates.

item.title: CVE-2026-121429 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | AzuraCast through 0.23.8 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows station users with Profile permission to execute OS commands via StereoTool settings. Attackers can inject shell metacharacters into stereo_tool_configuration_path or stereo_tool_license_key, which are executed via /bin/sh on station restart, compromising the container.

item.title: CVE-2026-121430 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the GET and POST /api/station/{station_id}/waveform/{media_id} routes, which lack Permissions middleware. Any authenticated user without station assignment can read another station's cached waveform JSON and overwrite it with attacker-supplied data, corrupting Visual Cue Editor data.

item.title: CVE-2026-121431 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows station users with WebHooks permission to bypass the UserUrlFilter guard via the Mastodon, Telegram, GroupMe, and RadioReg connectors. Attackers can set instance_url, api, or webhookurl to internal addresses and trigger the webhook test endpoint to reach loopback, private-network, or cloud-metadata services.

item.title: CVE-2026-121432 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows low-privilege station users to inject playlist entries by embedding CR/LF sequences in mount or remote relay display_name values. Attackers with Station:MountPoints or Station:RemoteRelays permission can inject FileN= and TitleN= lines into the public playlist.pls to redirect guest listeners to attacker-controlled streams under the victim station's name.

item.title: CVE-2026-121433 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a stored CSV formula injection vulnerability that allows station users with Media permission to persist formula-prefixed metadata via bulk media import. Attackers can import crafted titles, artists, or custom fields through /api/station/{station_id}/files/bulk so formulas evaluate when other users open exported CSVs in spreadsheets.

item.title: CVE-2026-121434 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Froxlor 2.3.0 before 2.3.15 contains a missing authorization check in the Certificates.add and Certificates.update API commands, which do not verify whether a domain's certificate is Let's Encrypt-managed. Customers with API access can overwrite the managed certificate and private key with an attacker-chosen pair, which a REBUILD_VHOST task deploys to the webserver, breaking HTTPS and desynchronizing ACME automation.

item.title: CVE-2026-121435 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Froxlor before 2.3.15 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated customers to create MySQL databases by calling the Mysqls.add API endpoint, which lacks the customer_hide_options check. Customers can invoke Mysqls.add even when the admin has disabled the MySQL feature, creating unauthorized databases within their own quota despite the policy.

item.title: CVE-2026-121436 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Froxlor from 2.3.8 before 2.3.15 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows administrators with customers_see_all to view every account's API key and secret through an unscoped WHERE 1 query in api_keys.php. Attackers can read the super administrator's apikey and secret from the detail modal and replay them to the API to gain super administrator control.

item.title: CVE-2026-121437 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Mistune from 3.3.0 before 3.3.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic-time emphasis delimiter processing. Attackers can submit small markdown documents with repeated patterns like "*a_b" to trigger an O(n²) index-fixup loop, stalling workers for seconds.

item.title: CVE-2026-121438 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Mistune before 3.3.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability in InlineParser.parse_link that allows attackers to cause quadratic CPU growth by supplying balanced nested brackets. Attackers can submit crafted Markdown with thousands of nested bracket pairs not forming a valid link, triggering repeated _contains_nested_link scans that exhaust CPU in parsing applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-121439 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.7 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.4 contains a response splitting vulnerability in wasi-http p3 that allows guests to set unvalidated content-length headers. Malicious wasip3 guests can splice an existing body into a new response with an incorrect content-length to perform response splitting or injection attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-121440 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.7 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.4 fails to check forwarded trailers against the WasiHttpHooks::is_forbidden_header hook in wasi-http p3. WASIp3 guests can forward a request or response body so its trailers skip embedder-customized forbidden header filtering, undermining header restrictions the embedder intended.

item.title: CVE-2026-121441 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Wasmtime before 36.0.19, 37.0.0 before 48.0.7, and 49.0.0 before 49.0.4 contains a request smuggling vulnerability in wasi-http that allows guests to set multiple conflicting content-length headers. Malicious guests can make the host send HTTP requests with conflicting content-length values to smuggle requests through servers or intermediaries that do not reject them.

item.title: CVE-2026-121442 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Frappe HRMS before 15.61.0 contains a permission bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated employees to view other employees' expense advance details due to improper authorization checks. Attackers can query the Expense Claim Advances API to retrieve expense advance records belonging to other employees, exposing sensitive financial information.

item.title: CVE-2026-121443 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | svg-sanitizer from 1.1.0 before 1.1.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows remote attackers to crash requests by submitting SVG input ending inside an unclosed tag. Attackers can upload truncated input like a single '<' to trigger an uncaught ValueError from strpos() in hasElementWithTooManyAttributes() or hasInternalDtdSubset() on PHP 8, failing the request.

item.title: CVE-2026-121444 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | svg-sanitizer from 0.11.0 before 1.1.0 contains an algorithmic complexity denial of service vulnerability in hasInfiniteLoop() and countUse() of the use reference-graph analysis. Attackers can upload a small layered SVG with 15 levels of fanned-out use elements, forcing exponential path enumeration that pins PHP workers for hours.

item.title: CVE-2026-121445 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | darylldoyle svg-sanitizer from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in the image-set pattern of stripRemoteCssTokens() when removeRemoteReferences is enabled. Attackers can submit SVGs with many unclosed image-set tokens to exhaust CPU, or trigger PCRE limits causing sanitize() to throw a TypeError and leave unsanitized content.

item.title: CVE-2026-121446 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | svg-sanitizer from 0.5.0 before 1.1.0 contains an incomplete filtering vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass remote URL removal by using CSS escape sequences inside url() in SVG presentation attributes. Attackers can supply SVG files with attributes like fill containing escaped slashes that browsers resolve to remote URLs, triggering external requests and enabling data exfiltration.

item.title: CVE-2026-121447 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | svg-sanitizer before 1.1.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass sanitization by placing javascript: URLs in the animateTransform values attribute. Attackers can upload crafted SVG files whose animateTransform targets the href attribute, executing arbitrary JavaScript when Safari users click the link.

item.title: CVE-2026-121448 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Dockhand before 1.0.54 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read, overwrite, and delete .env files outside the stacks root by double-encoding the stack name. Attackers can send %252e%252e sequences to /api/stacks/[name]/env/raw to disclose cross-environment secrets, write into protected directories, or poison deployment variables.

item.title: CVE-2026-121449 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Dockhand from 1.0.47 before 1.0.54 exposes plaintext stack secrets because deployStack() attaches resolved secret values to its result as resolvedSecrets, which Git-stack routes return unfiltered. Holders of a stack's webhook secret or users with stacks:start permission can trigger the Git stack webhook, manual deploy, or create-and-deploy endpoints to receive stored and external-provider secrets such as 1Password or Vault values.

item.title: CVE-2026-121505 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 3.7
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 3.7 | An out-of-bounds read in the NTS-KE client response parser (nts_client_process_response_core) in NTPsec before 1.2.4 allows a malicious NTS-KE server to read the client's stack memory, including pointers that defeat ASLR, which the client then sends in cleartext as NTS cookies, via an NTS-KE record whose declared length exceeds the data received.

item.title: CVE-2026-121506 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.4
item.description: Tuesday 3 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.4 | An out-of-bounds read and write in NTS client extension field parsing (extens_client_recv) in NTPsec before 1.2.5 allows a remote attacker who can send NTP server-mode replies to an NTS client to corrupt heap memory and crash ntpd, and, combined with the NTS-KE client out-of-bounds read fixed in 1.2.4, to bypass NTS authentication and set the client's time, via an NTS Authenticator and Encrypted Extension Fields field whose nonce length exceeds the field.
